description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Buff Holy 30% (15s)], [Buff Ice 30% (15s)], [Buff Fire 30% (15s)], [Awoken Retainer], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Trinity Rush Finisher] to the user

description.name: Awoken Retainer
description.text: Knight and Samurai abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Knight and Samurai abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Fire 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Trinity Rush
description.text: 2/3/4/5/6/7/8 single attacks (0.96 each) capped at 19999 if the user used 0/2/4/6/8/10/12 Knight or Samurai abilities. Additional one single attack (5.35) capped at 99999
